heroSummary: Corona-Norco USD begins the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, July 6, 2026 for the earliest Elementary A-D track. Traditional elementary and secondary schedules begin Monday, August 10, 2026, and the latest reviewed CNUSD date marker is Thursday, June 24, 2027.
calendarNotes: Corona-Norco USD publishes separate 2026-2027 elementary and secondary calendar PDFs. The earliest elementary A-D track instruction begins in July 2026, while Traditional elementary and secondary schedules begin in August 2026. Families should use the matching PDF for their student's school level and track because minimum days, early release days, inservice days, teacher prep days, late starts, and track-change dates vary across CNUSD calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When does the CNUSD 2026-2027 school year start?
calendarFaqs.a: CNUSD start dates vary by track. The earliest elementary A-D track instruction begins in July 2026, while Traditional elementary and secondary schedules begin in August 2026. Families should verify the exact start date in the PDF for their student's school and track.

calendarFaqs.q: Why are there two CNUSD PDFs for 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The complete CNUSD 2026-2027 calendar is split between an Elementary Calendar and a Secondary Calendar. Both PDFs are needed for a full district-level reference.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CNUSD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The CNUSD calendars mark Thanksgiving Break during the week of November 23-27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CNUSD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The CNUSD calendars mark Winter Break beginning December 21, 2026. Return dates vary by track and school level, so families should verify the matching PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CNUSD have minimum days and early release days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The elementary and secondary calendars mark early release, minimum days, inservice days, teacher prep days, late starts, and track-change dates where applicable.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Corona-Norco USD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Corona-Norco USD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: CNUSD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content: The Corona-Norco USD 2026-2027 calendar is split into two official PDFs: the Elementary Calendar and the Secondary Calendar. Elementary students may follow A, B, C, D, or Traditional tracks. Secondary students may follow Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, or JFK Middle College schedules. This page combines the two source files into a planning reference, but families should always confirm dates against the PDF for their student's campus and track.

customSections.label: CNUSD Track Calendar Guide 2026-2027
customSections.content: CNUSD uses track labels instead of one districtwide calendar grid. Elementary calendars include A, B, C, D, and Traditional tracks. Secondary calendars include Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, and JFK Middle College schedules. Families should match the PDF row to the student's campus group before planning around first days, last days, minimum days, early releases, and late starts.

customSections.content: CNUSD families should identify the student's school level and track before relying on any single date from the district calendar.

customSections.label: CNUSD Minimum Days and Early Release Days
customSections.content: CNUSD minimum days and early release days can vary by elementary track, secondary group, and campus schedule. A minimum day usually means students attend for a shortened day, while early release and late-start notes may affect pickup, transportation, childcare, and after-school activities. Families should verify exact dates and times in the matching elementary or secondary PDF instead of assuming one districtwide minimum-day schedule.

customSections.label: CNUSD Holidays 2026-2027
customSections.content: CNUSD holidays and common no-school markers include federal holidays, Thanksgiving week, winter holidays, and spring or June holiday markers. Track-specific return dates may still vary.

customSections.label: How to Add the CNUSD Calendar to Google Calendar
customSections.content: Download the CNUSD ICS file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the file, and confirm the imported dates. The ICS file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync. Families should still use the elementary or secondary PDF for track-specific minimum days, early releases, and campus-level updates.

customSections.label: Family Planning Guide for CNUSD 2026-2027
customSections.content: Corona-Norco USD families often need to coordinate childcare and travel around track-specific dates. The safest planning workflow is to identify the student's campus, confirm whether the student follows an elementary A, B, C, D, or Traditional track or a secondary Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, or JFK schedule, then use the matching PDF for exact minimum days, early dismissals, late starts, and no-school days.

customSections.label: How We Verify CNUSD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official CNUSD school calendars and bell schedules page, the elementary calendar PDF, and the secondary calendar PDF. Dates are checked separately for elementary A, B, C, D, and Traditional tracks, plus secondary Orange Grove, Intermediate, High School, and JFK Middle College schedules.

The official CNUSD calendars remain the source of record for revisions, school-specific schedules, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
